cycle: E2E-agent-1 limited causal repair (NOT a reimplementation; frozen frontends/solver/program space preserved)

repaired_defect.description: claim-channel uncertainty (CLAIM_UNTYPED, ENTITY_UNBOUND, SOURCE_UNBOUND, TIME_UNBOUND, claim failures) entered hard_reasons and every world's markers, and the baseline solver short-circuits markered worlds to UNKNOWN — masking certified independent Policy/Goal/factual violations behind unrelated claim UNKNOWN
target_invariant: independent certified violation + unrelated UNKNOWN -> PROVED_ERROR
UNKNOWN never manufactures ERROR and never certifies NO_ERROR

preserved_strengths: historical provenance of all sealed artifacts
conservative temporal/effect/state evidence semantics (Agent-2 stale-state logic NOT imported)

arms.A0: unchanged E2E-agent-1 (repair=None; MUST reproduce the sealed E0 predictions exactly — hard-verified at arms phase)
arms.A1: A0 + scoped claim-UNKNOWN composition (scoped_status_v1: FALSE and UNKNOWN = FALSE; certifiable conjuncts require their axis enumeration-complete; PROVED_NO_ERROR keeps full baseline strictness)
arms.A2: A1 + deterministic claim value anchoring (claim_adapter_v2: LITERAL_VALUE and COMPLETION_EFFECT anchors; same pure function in pipeline and checker)
arms.A3: A2 + catalog-identity binding of unexercised semantic atoms (binding_repair_v1: action:/event: atoms whose suffix is exactly a catalog tool name; no argument checks, no entity path; ledger alone proves calls/absence)

data.development: E2E V1 fresh corpus (69 cases, 42 cohorts, gold by construction, sealed) — the ONLY data used; zero new LLM calls (deterministic replay of sealed semantic outputs)
data.headline_fresh: STOP before any fresh/headline evaluation: the shared Agent-1/Agent-2 holdout has not been provided in this repository for this comparison cycle; no future shared gold is generated or read

metrics_per_arm: paired vs A0: corrections, regressions, McNemar exact p, Newcombe CI

selection_rule.eligibility: all hard invariants pass AND false-certified ERROR count <= A0's count (no new false ERROR budget)
selection_rule.note: the minimal-intervention tie-break is deliberate: when later arms add no measured gain, the smallest repair is frozen

prohibited: new Policy parser / Goal architecture / solver
importing Agent-2 aggressive BOTH-aware stale-state semantics (stale contradiction -> ERROR)
binding atoms to tools absent from the case catalog
reading or generating future shared holdout gold
controlled_tests: tests/test_e2e_scoped_repair.py (9 mandatory scenarios + scoped algebra + anchor/repair units + certificate mutation + A0 invariance)
disclosed_fixes_en_route: policy_composition_v1.make_grs_frontend: synth-UNAVAILABLE path passed 9 args to GRSResult (8 expected) and raised TypeError instead of returning UNAVAILABLE (crash fix only; unreachable in the sealed live run, no behavior change on non-crashing paths)

certificate checker scoped path: PROVED_ERROR under scoped semantics no longer requires blanket MATERIAL_RESPONSE_COVERED / SEMANTIC_CANDIDATES_COVERED — the epistemic load moves to per-conjunct axis completeness (the scoped repair itself); PROVED_NO_ERROR requirements unchanged
